qualification: literature-informed research assumptions; not a foundry corner or manufacturing qualification
temperature_note: Near-room-temperature comparison evaluated at an assumed 20 C; the cited film values are not a calibrated temperature model. No 85/125 C prediction is made.
geometry_policy: Keep #206 ODB/DEF/GDS and #215 conductor geometry, M10 landings, 2um wire width/thickness, 2um spacing, 2x2um cuts, 0.8um ILD gap, and epsilon_r=3.9 unchanged.

baseline.qualification: Original uncalibrated research model, not measured aluminum.

sources.title: Integrated Electrochemical Deposition of Copper Metallization for Ultralarge-Scale Integrated Circuits
sources.authors: S.-Y. Chang, C.-W. Lin, H.-H. Hsu, J.-H. Fang, S.-J. Lin
sources.publication: Journal of The Electrochemical Society 151(1), C81-C88 (2004)
sources.locator: p. C86, Fig. 10 and adjacent paragraph
sources.evidence: 1900nm electroplated film: 2.04 microohm cm as deposited and 1.77 after 400C anneal; 180nm film: 2.32 as deposited. Anneal temperature is a fabrication condition, not operating temperature.

sources.title: Copper evolution and beyond: Developments in advanced interconnects for future CMOS nodes
sources.evidence: Barrier/liner reduces effective copper cross section; material name alone does not specify line or via resistance.

capacitance.method: Reuse SHA-bound whole-layout #215 field.spef CAP records unchanged after geometry/dielectric/field-input checks. Re-extract DC R with OpenRCX and read each combined SPEF independently into original OpenDB.
capacitance.reason: The qualified electrostatic field solver treats all nets as perfect conductors; its inputs contain geometry, dielectric, reference plane and excitation, not metal resistivity.

corners.name: cu-main
corners.source: chang2004, 1900nm as-deposited film; transferred to assumed 2um effective thickness
corners.via_assumption: Hold total via10/via11 resistance at the original uncalibrated 0.08ohm to isolate wire material; this is not a measured copper via parameter.

corners.name: cu-low-rho
corners.source: chang2004, 1900nm film after 400C anneal; optimistic material sensitivity, no assumption that the base chip supports that anneal

corners.name: cu-high-rho
corners.source: chang2004, thinner 180nm as-deposited film; deliberately pessimistic sensitivity for this geometry, not a measured 2um film or statistical bound

corners.name: cu-ideal-via
corners.source: Analytic rho*h/A at h=0.8um, A=2x2um^2 using main copper resistivity
corners.via_assumption: Ideal uniform Cu barrel for both via10/via11; zero contact, liner and spreading contributions. Lower-bound diagnostic only, including the unknown M10 interface.
